title: thymus pulegioides var. vestitus
intro: Thymus pulegioides var. vestitus, commonly known as Wild Thyme, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family, native to the Mediterranean region. The health benefits of Wild Thyme include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to alleviate respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, and soothe digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Wild Thyme include its ability to act as an expectorant, antispasmodic, and antiseptic, making it useful in treating a range of conditions, from bronchitis to insect bites. The bioactive constituents of Wild Thyme include essential oils, such as carvacrol and thymol, which possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
